current.changeLog:
Actionable, self-clearing done ticks — a researched module tick now buys and mounts the module and clears itself; field-mod done ticks clear when you open the screen.
Estimated battles remaining — tooltips now show an ≈ M–N battles estimate beside the XP shortfall, calibrated from your best-game pace and average, with reserve/first-win bonuses factored in.

previous.changeLog:
# Weekly Playlist (new)

A new automatic playlist that displays vehicles matching the current 3-week missions — filtered according to their vehicle restrictions (sub-role, class, nation, level). Sorted by priority within the list: first vehicles with missing Field Mods, then vehicles close to a Gunmark, then the rest. Is automatically rebuilt when you reroll a mission.

current.changeLog:

previous.changeLog: Fixed scheduled reserves creating duplicate, inactive notifications when changed during battle. A single updated control notification now appears after returning to the Garage.
